--- # Get Campaign Message > This is the Markdown version of https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/get_campaign_message ```http GET https://a.klaviyo.com/api/campaign-messages/{id} ``` Get a campaign message by ID. - Revision header: `revision: 2026-10-15` (required) - Scopes: `campaigns:read` - Rate limits: Burst: `10/s`, Steady: `150/m` - OpenAPI: [Download this endpoint's OpenAPI document](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/2026-10-15/openapi/stable/apis/get_campaign_message.json) ## Example request ### curl ```bash curl --request GET \ --url 'https://a.klaviyo.com/api/campaign-messages/id' \ --header 'Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key' \ --header 'accept: application/vnd.api+json' \ --header 'revision: 2026-10-15' ``` ### CLI ```bash klaviyo campaigns get-campaign-message id ``` Sign in first with `klaviyo auth login`. [Install the Klaviyo CLI](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/klaviyo_cli.md) ### Python ```python from klaviyo_api import KlaviyoAPI klaviyo = KlaviyoAPI("your-private-api-key") response = klaviyo.Campaigns.get_campaign_message("id") ``` Install it with `pip install klaviyo-api`. [The Python SDK on GitHub](https://github.com/klaviyo/klaviyo-api-python) ### Node.js ```javascript import { ApiKeySession, CampaignsApi } from 'klaviyo-api' const session = new ApiKeySession('your-private-api-key') const campaignsApi = new CampaignsApi(session) const response = await campaignsApi.getCampaignMessage('id') ``` Install it with `npm install klaviyo-api`. [The Node.js SDK on GitHub](https://github.com/klaviyo/klaviyo-api-node) ### Ruby ```ruby require 'klaviyo-api-sdk' KlaviyoAPI.configure do |config| config.api_key['Klaviyo-API-Key'] = 'Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key' end response = KlaviyoAPI::Campaigns.get_campaign_message('id') ``` Install it with `gem install klaviyo-api-sdk`. [The Ruby SDK on GitHub](https://github.com/klaviyo/klaviyo-api-ruby) ### PHP ```php Campaigns->getCampaignMessage('id'); ``` Install it with `composer require klaviyo/api`.
